reforms.description: As part of the Inflation Reduction Act, Medicare will be able to directly negotiate prescription drug prices with manufacturers and impose a tax penalty if drug companies increase their prices faster than inflation.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: This reform aims to reduce drug prices, potentially increasing access to medications and improving public health outcomes, which can support economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The reform is part of the Inflation Reduction Act, which has been implemented.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform represents a significant structural change in how drug prices are negotiated, impacting the healthcare sector broadly.
reforms.source_quote: As part of the recent Inflation Reduction Act, Medicare will be able to directly negotiate prescription drug prices with manufacturers and impose a tax penalty if drug companies increase their prices faster than inflation.

reforms.description: The Inflation Reduction Act expands clean energy tax credits for various technologies, including wind, solar, nuclear, clean hydrogen, and carbon capture, while also providing US$1 billion in grants to state and local governments for adopting stringent building energy codes and offering up to US$14,000 in rebates for low- and middle-income households to purchase energy-efficient appliances and electric vehicles.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: These incentives are designed to stimulate investment in clean energy technologies and improve energy efficiency, which can lead to job creation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The reform is part of the Inflation Reduction Act, which has been implemented.
reforms.importance_rationale: The expansion of clean energy tax credits and grants represents a major shift in federal support for clean energy technologies.
reforms.source_quote: As part of the Inflation Reduction Act, low- and middle-income households now benefit from up to US$14,000 in direct consumer rebates to purchase heat pumps, other energy efficient home appliances, and for upgrading home electric systems to support electrification.

reforms.description: The Inflation Reduction Act includes US$200 million in grants for training contractors involved in the installation of home energy efficiency and electrification improvements.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Training contractors enhances the workforce's skills in energy efficiency, which can lead to better implementation of energy-saving technologies and contribute to economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The reform is part of the Inflation Reduction Act, which has been implemented.
reforms.importance_rationale: While significant, this reform is narrower in scope compared to the broader clean energy incentives.
reforms.source_quote: The Inflation Reduction Act includes US$200 million in grants for training contractors involved in installation of home energy efficiency and electrification improvements.

reforms.description: The Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act includes US$5 billion over five years to build charging stations for electric vehicles, aiming to enhance infrastructure for EV adoption.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Investing in EV charging infrastructure supports the transition to electric vehicles, which can reduce emissions and promote sustainable economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The reform is part of the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, which has been implemented.
reforms.importance_rationale: This investment represents a significant commitment to enhancing the infrastructure necessary for the adoption of electric vehicles.
reforms.source_quote: The Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act passed in November 2021 also includes US$5 billion over five years to be spent on building charging stations.
